name: Cosmic War
summary:
Step into this uniquely atmospheric game, where your goal is simple:

Defeat waves of increasingly powerful enemies. During each run, upgrade your stats to adapt and survive as long as possible.

It features a tutorial, a standard mode where you must defeat all enemy waves, and an endless mode that challenges you to last as long as you can.

You can also compare your scores with other players in the built-in leaderboard.
